> Do not include credentials, private repository contents, exploit details, or sensitive local-machine data. For security issues, follow `SECURITY.md`.

## Affected version

Commit SHA, release, or branch:

## Environment

OS, Node version, browser/provider path, and relevant WAG mode:

## Expected behavior

What should have happened?

## Observed behavior

What happened instead?

## Minimal reproduction

Provide the smallest safe sequence that reproduces the issue.

## Authority / security impact

Does this affect capability boundaries, approvals, local files, credentials, durable ownership, native-host trust, or signing/release behavior?

## Verification notes

Include relevant redacted logs, failing tests, or screenshots only when they do not expose sensitive data.
